name: The Kingsward
description:
About This Game

The Kingsward combines an open-world RPG with isometric ARPG mechanics, delivering an epic adventure with a strong humorous and satirical tone.

Explore diverse ecosystems, discover a vast world with secrets around every corner, customize your character with a hybrid class system, gather resources, craft gear… and embark on the quest for the legendary Kingsward to save the kingdom from the king’s stupidity!


A Vast Open World to Explore

Explore a massive world filled with:

  • Unique items hidden in remote corners of the map

  • Dungeons, caves, and puzzles with distinct challenges

  • More than 7 distinct macro-zones

  • Hundreds of enemies

Find a secret cave in a mountain, a one-of-a-kind magical ring inside a chest after leaping off a cliff, a magic sword buried beneath a waterfall, or a strange character with a unique quest in a cabin in the middle of nowhere.

The world is packed with things to discover!

Hybrid Class System

  • 3 playable races

  • 16 unlockable subclasses

Shape your own playstyle:

  • Mix abilities across different classes

  • Unlock new options as you level up

  • Gain unique traits

  • Train weapon masteries to define your combat style

No rigid builds. You decide how it plays:

A hypocritical paladin who uses zombies in combat
A stealthy hunter wearing 60 tons of iron armor
A mage who punches enemies with bare fists
A warrior addicted to magical staves

A true RPG!

Gather, Craft, and Trade

  • Gather materials in the world, craft and upgrade your gear

  • Level up your professions: mining, gathering, crafting, mercantilism.

  • Create your own trade routes!

Hundreds of Items

  • Swords, daggers, staves, hammers, spears, axes, two-handed axes, bows, two-handed swords, scythes, and fist weapons.

  • Heavy, medium, and cloth armor.

  • Every ring in the game has a unique, one-of-a-kind effect. No "+4 mana"—rings call down lightning on your enemies.

Epic Story… With a Twist

A narrative that avoids genre clichés.

Developed alongside stand-up comedians, The Kingsward delivers an epic, satirical story packed with memorable dialogue. Expect as much drama as comedy.

The game was written around a simple critique: characters in games rarely say anything interesting.

So every line of dialogue has been carefully crafted with intent!

Every NPC has something to say… and it’s worth hearing.

Optimized for PC and Handhelds

Designed to deliver a smooth experience on both desktop PCs and handheld devices.

We’re Not Here to Rip You Off!

  • No microtransactions

  • Affordable price

  • No Artificial Intelligence

  • Free updates
short_desc: Explore an open-world Sandbox RPG with isometric ARPG combat, a flexible hybrid class system, and an epic story with satirical humor. Create your own build and seek the legendary Kingsward.
